have you smoked cigarettes at any time in your life?

response_options.answer_option: i have never smoked a cigarette
i have smoked fewer than 50 cigarettes (2 1/2 packs) altogether in my life
i have smoked 50 or more cigarettes in my entire life

components.text: thinking back to the time in your life when you were smoking the most:

children.text: how soon after you woke up did you smoke your first cigarette?
how often did you make sure that you had cigarettes to smoke?
was it difficult not to smoke in places where smoking was not allowed, such as at work, in a movie theater, or at church?
if you could not smoke a cigarette for several hours, how strong would your craving be?
one pack equals 20 cigarettes.
how many cigarettes would you typically smoke per day when smoking most heavily?

components.text: have you ever had an alcoholic drink, that is beer, wine, or liquor (vodka, whiskey, brandy, etc.)?

response_options.answer_option: i have never had an alcoholic drink
i have had fewer than 10 alcoholic drinks altogether in my life
i have had at least 10 alcoholic drinks altogether in my life

components.text: at the time in your life when you were drinking the most:

children.text: how often did you have an alcoholic drink?
how many alcoholic drinks did you have on a typical day when you were drinking?

components.text: during the period that you were drinking the most, how often

children.text: did you have six or more drinks on one occasion?
did you find that you were unable to stop drinking once you started?
did you fail to do what was normally expected of you because of drinking?
did you have a drink first thing in the morning to get yourself going?
did you feel guilty after drinking?
were you unable to remember what happened because you had been drinking?
were you or someone else injured as the result of your drinking?
was a relative, friend, or a doctor or other health worker concerned about your drinking or did they suggest that you cut down?

components.text: looking back over your entire life, have you ever had a time when you were feeling depressed, down, or sad most of the time for at least two weeks?

response_options.answer_option: yes [only after the death of a loved one]
yes [not only after the death of a loved one]
